trust_decision.summary: Whether a protocolMessage of a type that only our own phone/other own devices may send (HISTORY_SYNC_NOTIFICATION, APP_STATE_SYNC_KEY_SHARE, LID_MIGRATION_MAPPING_SYNC, PEER_DATA_OPERATION_REQUEST_RESPONSE_MESSAGE) may mutate local state is decided per message at the single protocolMessage dispatcher, by a new SELF_ONLY_TYPES set membership test on protocolMsg.type combined with message.key.fromMe.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says a maliciously crafted protocolMessage payload causes message upsert / hist-sync spoofing and app-state corruption; the only code that dispatches protocolMessage.type to local state is this switch.

fix_sites.entry_point: makeWASocket inbound message pipeline: CB:message -> handleMessage -> upsertMessage -> processMessage (src/Socket/messages-recv.ts:1999, src/Socket/messages-recv.ts:1775, src/Socket/chats.ts:1310); second inbound path is the newsletter plaintext notification, CB:notification type=newsletter -> handleNewsletterNotification (src/Socket/messages-recv.ts:1042-1043, src/Socket/messages-recv.ts:511-529) which also calls upsertMessage
fix_sites.module_kind: message-processing utility (src/Utils), called only from src/Socket/chats.ts:1310

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 route a solver can say the sync state machine in upsertMessage is only lifecycle bookkeeping (when to flush, when to resync) while the history payload itself is processed and now dropped inside processMessage, so a stranger's notification 'cannot reach the sink'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Protocol message types that legitimately arrive from other users must keep being applied: REVOKE, MESSAGE_EDIT, EPHEMERAL_SETTING, GROUP_MEMBER_LABEL_CHANGE; an over-broad 'drop every protocolMessage when !fromMe' (or a type allowlist error) silently stops other users' deletes and edits, and also stops our own phone's history sync / PDO response, which arrive with fromMe=true.

O6_input_shapes: protocolMessage.type restricted to the four self-only enum values while four other types in the same field must still run for strangers (fix.diff:33-38, fix.diff:23-26)
protocolMsg.type null/undefined, i.e. proto3 unset type (fix.diff:39-42)
sender origin flag message.key.fromMe true vs false (fix.diff:43)

protocolMessage nested inside wrapper content (ephemeralMessage, viewOnceMessage, documentWithCaptionMessage, editedMessage, associatedChildMessage, groupStatusMessage*) because the guard runs on the normalizeMessageContent output (src/Utils/process-message.ts:322, src/Utils/messages.ts:805-817)
deviceSentMessage-wrapped protocolMessage: unwrapped before dispatch, so the envelope's fromMe decides (src/Utils/decode-wa-message.ts:335)

O7_producer.where: src/Utils/decode-wa-message.ts:141-236 (fromMe derived at :187-189, :206, :214-216 and stored in the key at :223-236), invoked from src/Utils/decode-wa-message.ts:264

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A non-self HISTORY_SYNC_NOTIFICATION still drives upsertMessage's history-sync state machine: sets initialBootstrapComplete/recentSyncComplete, emits messaging-history.status, runs resyncAppState(ALL_WA_PATCH_NAMES, true) and ev.flush(), with no fromMe check; the fix only returns early inside processMessage, after this code already ran.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It only decides when to flush the event buffer and when to start an app-state resync; the attacker-supplied history payload itself is processed in processMessage and is now dropped there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different directory: src/Utils (landing point) to src/Socket, one hop from the sink's only caller; the state machine is at src/Socket/chats.ts:1219-1301

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A non-self APP_STATE_SYNC_KEY_SHARE still triggers a full app-state resync (doAppStateSync -> resyncAppState(ALL_WA_PATCH_NAMES)) whenever syncState === Syncing; only the key storage inside processMessage is guarded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The key itself is rejected by the new guard, and reacting to a key-share with a sync is needed for our own devices' key share, so the envelope check looks unnecessary here.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/Utils/process-message.ts to src/Socket/chats.ts, second consumer in the caller file of the guarded function

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Keep SELF_ONLY_TYPES membership but let the APP_STATE_SYNC_KEY_SHARE branch write keys and emit creds.update myAppStateKeyId for non-self senders, or guard only the history case.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The switch already hand-rolls per-type state writes, so a maintainer adding the guard for the type named in the report would plausibly leave the neighbouring branch as-is.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A PDO response branch that still emits messages.upsert with a fully attacker-chosen WAMessage key/bytes while the guard covers only the state writes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This branch re-emits a whole decoded WebMessageInfo; guarding the key store but not the re-emitted upsert is a natural partial fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-route origin check for the newsletter plaintext path, which builds a WAMessage with a hardcoded fromMe:false from arbitrary publisher bytes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second, unencrypted message constructor outside the Signal pipeline, so a handler-level fix (rather than a sink-level one) would either duplicate or omit the check here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An origin check before the appStateSyncKeyShare-triggered resync, mirroring the processMessage guard in the caller.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The sync trigger lives in the caller next to the state machine and was written before the guard existed, so the same check is needed twice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: LID-PN mapping writes plus migrateSession from an unverified envelope participantAlt claim, next to the LID_MIGRATION_MAPPING_SYNC writes at src/Utils/process-message.ts:505-521.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both feed the same signalRepository.lidMapping store and session migration, so a maintainer could plausibly add the same origin check to the envelope path.

O9_family: origin-validation / spoofing of control-plane protocol messages (CWE-290, CWE-345, CWE-346) leading to local state and app-state corruption

O10_build.project_tests: jest, npm test with testMatch '**/*.test.ts' (package.json:39). No test covers this origin guard: src/__tests__/Utils/process-message.test.ts only exercises cleanMessage/getChatId, src/__tests__/Utils/history.test.ts only processHistoryMessage; the fix diff adds no tests.
